messages:
jamal: heads-up — receiving multiple escalations from EU customers: persistent SSE disconnects and partial streams since ~09:12UTC. Customers report streams ending with `...[TRUNCATED]` and clients getting HTTP 502/504 on the final chunk. INC-2042 opened.

maria (support): customer examples — two big accounts in eu-west. They see this across different SDKs (js + python) and also raw curl. Said it started after a short spike then never fully recovered.

linda (oncall): tagging SRE, is there a known maintenance or routing change in eu-west? :rotating_light:

oliver (infra): nothing scheduled in the window. I'm seeing spikes in egress retries from the eu-west edge -> upstream inference pool around 09:10-09:14. Packet drops and connection resets.

eng-sre-bot: Alert: stream-reset-rate (eu-west) > baseline x8 at 09:12 UTC. Throttled connections: 3,200.

sree (head-sre): can you paste a snippet of the edge logs + client side error? we need to know whether it's auth, proxy timeouts, or backend worker churn.

jamal: paste of client error (redacted token):

```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Connection: close

event: error
data: {"error":"upstream stream reset","code":502}
```

and edge log excerpt: `edge-proxy[euwest-01] 2026-03-15T09:12:24Z downstream reset: ECONNRESET upstream: 10.8.2.67:443 tcp reset after read`

maria (support): also saw some auth rejections ~09:11 from token verification service, but those were low volume vs the stream resets. Putting both in the ticket.

oliver (infra): digging — I see NAT port exhaustion on the egress NAT gateway for eu-west caused by ephemeral connections peaking during a large burst of short-lived streaming requests. When ephemeral pool is full, some connections hang and then reset when the proxy attempts new upstream sockets.

linda (oncall): confirm timeframe matches customer reports. Does fallback routing to a different region work? We should test a cross-region reroute for a couple of sessions.

oliver (infra): yes we can Reroute using policy `route: eu-west -> na-west` for accounts with `allowFailover=true`. I'll spin up a canary route for 5% of connections from the impacted LB.

jamal: repro steps for support to validate client behavior: 1) Start a SSE stream using curl to streaming endpoint with chunked body. 2) Rapidly open/close 50 concurrent streams from 1 host to simulate ephemeral port pressure. 3) Observe `downstream reset` and partial output. I'll attach a small python repro later.

eng-sre-bot: Runbook suggestion: if NAT exhaustion suspected -> increase ephemeral port pool on NAT, enable connection reuse at proxy, or enable egress pool autoscale.

oliver (infra): quick mitigation path A: increase NAT ephemeral ports (risky on prod, needs change window). Path B (fast): enable connection pooling on edge-proxy and mark connection TTL longer to avoid churn. Path C (customer-level): enable region failover to na-west.

sree (head-sre): do path C immediately for a subset while infra implements pooling. We need to reduce customer impact now.

linda (oncall): maria, can you coordinate opt-in failover with the two largest customers? Ask if they accept cross-region failover (note: increased latency). Also update status page with a brief message — "intermittent streaming interruptions in EU-WEST; mitigation in progress".

maria (support): pinged customers, both accepted failover. Also asked for any repro logs and SDK versions.

oliver (infra): rolling out route override for accounts with allowFailover. `kubectl apply -f route-override-euw2-naw-canary.yaml` (canary 5%). deploy-bot: started rollout.

deploy-bot: Rolling update: route-override-euw2-naw-canary -> 5% -> OK -> 20% -> OK -> 100% for allowFailover=true groups.

jamal: after reroute to na-west, one customer reported streams resumed but with slightly higher token latency (~120ms extra). They stopped seeing the partial truncation. :thumbsup:

linda (oncall): status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2042 (short note + next update planned in 30m).

oliver (infra): while failover stabilized traffic we also patched edge-proxy config to keep `Connection: keep-alive` reuse active and bumped upstream connection TTL to 120s. Expect fewer ephemeral connections. I also opened SRE-987 to track NAT pool autoscale work.

jamal: added repro script here (support paste) — small python snippet that opens 200 short SSE connections in a tight loop. Repro reliably shows resets when NAT pool exhausted.

maria (support): customers confirmed degraded degraded -> recovered after failover. We'll keep them on the failover path while infra completes NAT autoscale.

eng-sre-bot: Metrics: stream-reset-rate (eu-west) dropping towards baseline after reroute. 30-minute window shows 75% drop.

sree (head-sre): good. Next steps: 1) permanent infra fix (NAT pool autoscale + connection pooling) 2) add graceful degradation for SDKs: automatic switch to long-polling fallback when continuous SSE failures detected 3) product to define cross-region failover opt-in default for critical customers.

linda (oncall): I'm scheduling an incident review at 1400 UTC today, will invite infra, SRE, product, and support. Please bring: timeline, NAT metrics, customer repro, and proposed config changes.

oliver (infra): I'll capture the kernel-level counters and NAT logs and create a runbook entry for ephemeral port monitoring.

jamal: filing a support playbook snippet to automate steps:

```
- Verify resets in edge logs
- Check NAT ephemeral usage
- If >80% -> trigger temporary region failover for allowFailover=true groups
- Patch edge to enable keep-alive pool
- Notify customers and update status
```

maria (support): created follow-up ticket INC-2042-FUP for customer outreach and billing review. Note: one customer asked about potential billing credits for downtime — flag for finance.

linda (oncall): finance/product can triage credits after RCA. For now focus on mitigating.

eng-sre-bot: Event closed: major impact reduced. Will create post-incident summary in #postmortems when RCA is ready.

sree (head-sre): thanks team — excellent cross-functional work. We'll circle back with details and ETA on permanent fixes.

oliver (infra): final note: temporary failover will remain in place for impacted accounts until NAT autoscale is fully validated. Rolling metrics will be monitored for 48h.

jamal: closing support loop for now. Logging full thread into INC-2042. Follow-up action items assigned in ticket. :white_check_mark:
